item.content:encoded:
I love this and everything about it. It's Wondertainment taken to its logical conclusion: it forces the Foundation to contain stuff by playing a game.

In other news, if authors adding entries could update this list with Task Forces they reference, it would be much appreciated. It's entirely optional, but really helps a) keeping track of how many articles MTFs are used in, and the natures and purposes of individual Task Forces, and b) easing the transition from 'non-canon' to 'maybe canon' (as per the 5 articles 3 authors rule).

item.content:encoded:
Agent Chang instructs Agent Arch to find supplies; impeded by blindness, they encounter the Supreme Divine Orange Card "Mysterious Mega-Malicious Meta-Meme", which immediately kills them. (Time remaining: 9m 05s.)

Yeah… and that was quick…

At this point, Researcher Pentach attempts to cheat by introducing a foreign card — "Pot of Greed", from the Yu-Gi-Oh card game — to the game. SCP-3301 accepts the card, dispensing two cards; both cards are copies of the Black Card "Pot of Weed", forcing Researcher Pentach to immediately draw two more cards for each. All four drawn cards are additional copies of "Pot of Weed"; all cards that Researcher Pentach draws using "Pot of Weed" are, invariably, additional copies of "Pot of Weed".

Now that's the highlight.
